pairedUpperBound: Paired facilities lack stable candidates; an upper-bound estimate is used.
pairedDecayUncertain: Some decaying candidates for paired facilities could not be verified.
pairedDecayNotConverged: The decay correction for paired facilities did not converge.
pairedScan: Too many operators are relevant to paired facilities; joint search uses pairwise scanning.
pairedWithoutAssistance: Paired facilities are evaluated without assistance even when assistance remains.
truncatedCandidates: Too many candidate combinations in one category; the search was truncated.
clueNote: Converted from 8,800,000 progress at a base rate of 100 points/s. Probability skills still determine the clue type.
operatorNote: Operator EXP uses battle-record equivalents; cognitive carriers count at 2.5×. Either EXP stage reward bundle A/B equals 170,000 EXP per 80 Sanity; the bundles are not assumed to stack.
weaponNote: Weapon EXP uses itemExp from WeaponExpItemTable. The highest weapon EXP stage equals 170,000 EXP per 80 Sanity.
growthNote: Converted using the highest-grade materials available for the selected growth plots and chamber level.
noFeasibleCrew: No stable or feasible schedule for this group
noCrew: 0 operators available; each chamber needs at least 1
centerHour: The control center shift change must be at a whole hour from 1 to 23
centerEmpty: Both control center shifts must be staffed or both must be empty
centerRecovery: Control center recovery does not match its roster
centerTimeline: Control center timeline does not match its roster or shift time
centerRecalculation: Control center consumption/recovery does not match independent recalculation
usedMask: usedMask does not match the operators assigned across the control center and facilities
tooManyCrew: The assigned operator count exceeds the roster size
availableCrew: {available} operators available; at least {required} are needed to fill all slots
duplicateAssignment: Operator {name} is assigned to both {previous} and {where}
centerCapacity: Each control center shift has at most {slots} slots
centerBalance: Control center shift {shift} does not satisfy R ≥ C (R={recovery}, C={consumption})
fillCount: {room}: filler count does not match the filler roster
crewCount: {room}, shift {shift}: invalid crew count ({skilled} skilled + {fill} fillers, {recorded} recorded, {slots} slots)
singleHasB: {room}: a single-shift schedule contains shift B operators
skilledFiller: {room}: an operator with a relevant skill is treated as an unskilled filler
bothShifts: {room}: the same operator is assigned to shifts A and B
assistDisabled: {room}: assistance is scheduled but disabled for this run
emptyDay: {room}: the assistance cycle contains an empty day
duplicateAssist: {room}: duplicate assistance targets on the same day
assistOutsideShift: {room}: assistance target {name} is not assigned to the assisted shift
notConverged: {room}: the simulation did not converge and cannot provide exact output
assistOutsideCycle: {room}: an assistance recipient is missing from the daily rotation
assistOverflow: {room}: assistance is invalid because the target morale is {mood}% > 70%
assistMissing: {room}: no assistance was recorded for scheduled recipient {name}
assistTime: {room}: assistance occurs outside the assisted shift
roomRecalculation: {room}: recalculated output {actual} does not match recorded output {recorded}
categoryRecalculation: Category {category}: recalculated output {actual} does not match recorded output {recorded}
missingFacility: Missing a schedule for required facility {room}
cycleBudget: Assistance cycle day {day} uses {points} points, exceeding the daily limit of {limit}
categoryVector: The objective vector for {category} does not match the category output
